what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Hybrid: in person at LMS Room D132 or on Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83227847126, Meeting ID 832 2784 7126); broadcast later on local access cable, Facebook and YouTube

items.why_it_matters: The committee reviews and approves the bills paid by the district for this period.

items.agenda_line: c. Renew Authorization for School Committee Chair to Sign Warrants
items.why_it_matters: The committee may renew the Chair's authority to sign the warrants that release payment of district bills.

items.agenda_line: a. Public Hearing: Anti Bullying and Prevention Plan
items.why_it_matters: Residents can comment at a public hearing on the district's anti-bullying and prevention plan.
The plan itself is listed under Action, so the committee may vote on it after the hearing.

items.agenda_line: d. Review of Continuation of Membership in the Massachusetts Association of School Committees
items.why_it_matters: The committee will review whether the district continues its membership in the state school committees association, which may involve dues.

items.agenda_line: e. Consideration of Special Education Reserve Fund Policy
items.why_it_matters: The committee will consider a policy on the special education reserve fund, which affects how money for special education is set aside.
The committee will discuss its priorities for the fiscal year 2028 school budget.

preview.hook: Warrant approvals, the Chair's authority to sign warrants, and a public hearing on the anti-bullying plan
preview.one_line: School Committee, Nov 4, 7pm (hybrid): warrants, the Chair's warrant-signing authority, and an anti-bullying plan hearing; also SpEd reserve policy and FY28 budget priorities.
